findings.evidence: The B-page body says an iterated completion collapses because the adic filtrations are cofinal, but the current item `ex-iterated-adic-completions` proves only the one-step comparison `\widehat M^I \cong \widehat M^{I^r} \cong \widehat M^{I+I^r}`. Reopening Stacks 10.96.2-10.96.3 shows that completion need not itself already be complete for arbitrary ideals, so cofinality alone does not justify the iterated-collapse sentence.
